biotools.summary: LightMyCells is a software resource within the BiaPy library that utilizes self-supervised Vision Transformers to predict fluorescence images from label-free transmitted light inputs, addressing phototoxicity limitations in fluorescence microscopy. It is described as a solution for the Cell Painting problem within the LightMyCells challenge.
